subject.title: fix(infra): converge legacy state migrations on archive collisions

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's remove-identical-or-archive-to-`.migrated.N` policy, with harmless imported residues reported as notices, once the shared plugin helper is updated too?
rationale: The code repair is concrete, but deleting or downgrading persisted legacy residues affects upgrade behavior and the PR carries the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Finish and accept narrow convergence
options.body: Update the shared helper and tests, then accept the policy only for sources that were already imported or preserved by an archive.

options.title: Keep all residues warning-blocking
options.body: Reject the notice path and require a different doctor repair that resolves every leftover before startup can proceed.

options.title: Split policy from implementation
options.body: Land only non-colliding archival mechanics now and defer warning-to-notice classification to a separate maintainer-sponsored change.

recommendation.title: Finish and accept narrow convergence
recommendation.body: Update the shared helper and tests, then accept the policy only for sources that were already imported or preserved by an archive.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the shared plugin SDK doctor helper consolidation and the plugin-state SQLite migration boundary most affected by the policy choice.
